published.source: Shaman PR (client 1.60.1.70425: new talent tree with Elemental Mastery, Fire Nova cut, Lava Burst and Mana Tide ranks, searched talents, 2026-10-16)

summary: Deep Elemental caster with a staff: Elemental Mastery, Lava Burst, Eye of the Storm, Thundering Strikes and Tidal Focus, from the client 70425 talent search. Windshaper Skyborne. The default Elemental build.
rotation: Pre-pull: Lightning Shield at -5.4 s, Mana Spring Totem at -3.9 s, Lightning Bolt at -2.9 s (lands 0.1 s after the pull), Searing Totem at -0.9 s
Elemental Mastery and the other cooldowns (Sapper, Demonic Rune, Major Mana Potion, Land Mine) as they come up
Mana Spring Totem when it is down and at least 20 s remain
Searing Totem when it is down and at least 20 s remain
Flame Shock whenever its DoT is down
Lava Burst on cooldown, unless Flame Shock would run out before the cast ends
Earth Shock once a Lightning Bolt would no longer land before the fight ends
Lightning Shield when it is down, above 50% mana with at least 60 s left (orbs fire at the target on raid damage hits, 1 a minute)
Lightning Bolt rank 10 as filler (no Chain Lightning on one target)
caveats: Two synthetic item level 71 trinkets: 37 spell power and 14 crit rating, and an on-use 140 spell power for 20 s every 2 min (at the pull, then on cooldown).
Lightning Bolt X's base damage is ×1.12, the raise a beta build gave the top playable rank. The client's 31+ ranks look untuned (rank 10 has about 201 base at a 0.714 coefficient).
Only the Tier 1 2-piece is active. The 5-piece (Lava Burst -1 s cooldown) would add more.
One 2% crit elixir per character. Owl on top of Sages would add about 10 if Forever allows it.
Elemental Focus proc rate on low ranks was reduced on 7 Oct. The exact amount is unknown.
Searing Totem's reach from a ranged shaman isn't modeled.
Raid damage hits on the shaman (1 a minute, each fires Lightning Shield) are estimated from boss timers. The assumptions panel also runs 0 and 10.
Call of Thunder is gone from the 70425 tree, so Elemental Mastery took its point. Eye of the Storm 3 keeps 70% of casts from being pushed back by the 2 raid hits a minute.
notes: mksettings -spec ele -apl level60 (standards 23: every shaman drops its own party totems; the raid has none, the shaman drops Mana Spring Totem itself); race SkyborneWindshaper (the best race since client 70425's Wind Blessed 3% haste).
